watch_levels.note: Next real H1 resistance, about 60 above spot. First genuine test of whether the upward resolution has acceptance or is another overshoot. Rule 9: a break here is NOT an entry.
H4 resistance and the session high, the next structural level once 63094.11 is cleared. Rule 9 applies: do not join a break here.

H1 support, 111 below spot and beneath the 62992.22 M15 support. Replaces 63005.58, which fired twice in three minutes on pokes of 0.63 and 2.63 points that were instantly recovered - it was marking a wick zone rather than the failure it was set to detect, the same defect that retired 62861.23 and 62966 earlier. Placed deep enough that only a genuine loss of the whole upward resolution can trigger it. Information, not an entry: rule 9 forbids joining the break.
H4 support, the next real structural floor. Reaching it would mean the upward resolution has fully unwound and the session is trending down rather than chopping.
